description:
Complete solution for keratosis pilaris, tiny bumps and strawberry skin🍓
  
 Our Strawberry Skin Pack contains: 
 ⭐  1% Salicylic Acid Body Wash  : Exfoliates and removes dead skin cells around and on top of ingrown hair 

⭐  10% AHA Body Scrub: It has 10% Lactic Acid which helps to provide deep exfoliation and boost cell turnover 
 
⭐  5% Lactic Acid Body Lotion : Removes dead cells on skin and stimulates cell renewal which reduces bumps and enhance texture 
 
❌You will not see results in just 1 month
✅ Use twice daily for 3 months for best results🗓️. Continue after that to prevent Strawberry Skin💙

 ⚠️Always follow it up with a broad-spectrum sunscreen during the day to avoid sun damage.
  
 📱Download the Be Bodywise app & save upto 30% using the app wallet!

Step 1: Apply adequate amount of bodywash on wet skin.
Step 2: Post bodywash, take some scrub and massage into skin using gentle, circular motions.
  Step 3 : Post shower, apply the moisturizing lotion all over the body 

Note: Use bodywash & lotion everyday. Use Scrub 1-2 times a week for best results

faqs.question: How long must I use this pack to see results?
faqs.answer: You will notice visible reduction in skin texture with 2-3 months of use. With KP or strawberry skin: changes depend on the severity of the condition, it is recommended to get in touch with an expert for your speicific case.

faqs.question: What are the side effects of this pack?
faqs.answer: There are no side effects. However, we always recommend you to do a patch test before using any skincare product for the first time.

faqs.question: What else can I use with this pack?
faqs.answer: You can use your regular spot treatments and sprays along with this kit. However - we don't recommend using retinol and vitamin c based based products on your body when using this kit.

faqs.question: Why should I use this bodywash?
faqs.answer: Enriched with Salicylic Acid - this is a bodywash that does more- it cleanses your pores, prevent acne formation and also helps gently exfoliate skin.

faqs.question: Will the lotion leave my skin sticky?
faqs.answer: No, this lightweight formula absorbs very quickly into the skin. It won't leave your skin sticky.
